discovery.description: Public x402 index: census of both bazars (CDP + PayAI), signed. A buyer discovers what's available before paying.

challenge.example: https://councilof.ai/api/proof?bundle=1 -> 402 with x402Version 2, accepts array (USDC on Base eip155:8453), extensions.bazaar
challenge.note: Proper x402 v2 challenge. Buyer sees exact price (10000 atomic = 0.01 USDC), network, asset contract, payTo address.

payment.settlement_flow: facilitator /verify then /settle unlocks the paid artefact

delivery.rule: Verification of every artefact stays free. Revenue is earned on issuance, assembly, and a durable signature — never a grade.

revenue_state.derivation: Counts read from counters.json + REVENUE_KV tallies. Nothing typed by hand. Null never 0.
revenue_state.north_of_truth: settled_usdc is the honest revenue number: USDC that cleared to the estate pay_to on Base. Chain adjudicates, not the CRM.
revenue_state.note: Revenue API does not publish prices. Metered amounts appear only in 402 challenges.

x402_census.conformance_rule: HTTP 402 AND PAYMENT-REQUIRED header AND x402Version 2 in body AND extensions.bazaar
x402_census.note: Not a seller's honesty, product quality, or price. Measurement, not certification.

honesty_note: Anonymous readback of public surfaces. No payment made, no receipt settled, no buyer journey completed end-to-end. The 402 challenge shape is verified as conformant. Actual settlement remains unmeasured from this lane (1 historical non-self settlement reported in revenue: 12 issuances + 1 proof).
